## Item 1 — LC handle drag: HOST-BLOCKED, spec'd (valid stop per brief)

Investigated read-only: `framework/gpu/3d.zig` `drawLoopCutOverlay` (L2959-2980) says verbatim "drawing only for now — wiring the drag needs the cart-side popup, req_2625 gap DD", but the real blocker is host-side:
- The host's native input loop owns every left-press while the model editor captures (`meshCapture(true)` for the whole session, ModelView.tsx:1113; engine.zig:4194-4238 routes presses to `meshGizmoHit` → face pick, motion to `meshGizmoDrag` at engine.zig:4671). The cart never sees those pointer events, so a cart-side drag is impossible — and a Pressable overlay was explicitly off the table.
- `meshGizmoHit`/`meshGizmoDrag` (3d.zig:2672/2696) know nothing about the lc handle; a click on it today falls through to a face pick that mutates the selection mid-session.
- No door echoes session state: only `__mesh_lc_begin/preview/end` exist (v8_bindings_core.zig:2158-2160). `LcSession` stores `last_dir`/`last_planes` but not `cuts`/`offset_frac`.

**Exact host work needed** (documented in-code at ModelView.tsx:520-532):
1. `LcSession` records `last_cuts: u32` + `last_offset_frac: f32` in `meshLoopCutFacePreview`.
2. 3d.zig: `meshLcHandleHit(mx,my)` (screen capsule test against the drawn handle segment — same geometry as `drawLoopCutOverlay`, `GIZMO_HIT_PX` threshold, checked BEFORE `meshGizmoHit` in engine.zig's lc-live press path) and `meshLcHandleDrag(dx,dy)` (pixel delta projected onto the handle's screen direction → delta in offset_frac = world-delta/span, clamp 0..1, internally call `meshLoopCutFacePreview(last_dir, last_cuts, new_frac)`); engine.zig routes motion/release like `me_gizmo_dragging`.
3. ONE read-back door `__mesh_lc_state()` → JSON `{ok, dir, cuts, offsetFrac, key, count}` (key/count required — the host-side preview re-installs a new mesh key the cart must adopt). Cart side then polls it while `lc` is non-null and mirrors into popup state without re-previewing. That polling is ~15 lines of cart work once the door exists; nothing was faked.

## Item 2 — LC harness ops: LANDED
`cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx` — ops doc L1233, ops L1283-1305: `lcbegin` (mirrors `openLoopCut`: `meshLcBegin` → seed popup state → even 1-cut preview), `lcprev:dir,cuts,off` (off = door's 0..1 frac; mirrors into popup as percent via `setLc` functional form — the harness closure is mount-frozen so `changeLoopCut`'s `lc` snapshot is stale there), `lcend:0|1`. Parser style identical to existing ops.

## Item 3 — Read-row right edge: LANDED
`cart/editor/inspector/ReadOnlySection.tsx:21-25` — `<C.HW_OvResetIdle />` appended after `HW_ReadValue`, mirroring OverrideField/PieceBody's always-reserved end column (endBtn + row gap = the 26px).

## Item 4 — ATLAS SETS bounded: LANDED
`cart/editor/library/ModelDetailBody.tsx:20-30, 84-104` — list wrapped in a nested `ScrollView` with explicit height (`atlasListHeight`, 34px `HW_ModelAtlasCard` rows, gap 4, cap 4 rows), exactly the ModelPaintVariants treatment. Caveat: no headless path exists to FOCUS a cooked (multi-atlas) model — the browser needs a click and there's no mouse harness — so the many-atlas overflow case is verified by pattern parity with the proven ModelPaintVariants scroll (visible working in the same shots); the fresh-cube MODEL FOCUS panel renders regression-free.

- `RJIT_MODELDOC=cube RJIT_MESHOPS="mode:3;sel:2;lcbegin;lcprev:0,3,0.5" ./tools/rjit shot editor --frames 120` → `.../scratchpad/lc_harness.png`: cyan cut accents (3 cuts), host handle drawn, popup reading direction 0 / cuts 3 / offset 0.50 (of 1.00u) — values match the op.
- `...lcprev:1,2,0.3;lcend:1;report` → `.../scratchpad/lc_commit.png`: popup closed, accents dropped, cut kept (TRI 12→52), UNDO 1 (one journal entry), face re-selected.
- `./tools/rjit shot editor --frames 40` → `.../scratchpad/inspector_rows.png`: PIECE/PLACE/SLOT TEMPLATE read values all end on one shared right edge, 26px inside the panel edge (the override grid).</result>
